probes.check: am_probe_stb_truetype_allocation(): opening a glyph packing context allocates through the facade, tagged stb-truetype.

seeded_violation.description: Compile stb_truetype's implementation without the STBTT_malloc and STBTT_free macros, so it uses the C runtime.

not_applicable.reason: stb_truetype's hooks are compile-time macros in its implementation: no stb_truetype code runs without them.

adaptation_notes: stb_truetype's allocation hooks are macros its implementation reads: the binding's glue is the one translation unit that defines STB_TRUETYPE_IMPLEMENTATION, with STBTT_malloc and STBTT_free calling the facade before it includes stb_truetype.h.
Bitmaps stb_truetype returns are released with stbtt_FreeBitmap, never free.
